featureFallbacks.001: Import a song from YouTube, Spotify or a local file, split it into six stems, mix them with a beat-synced metronome and save named mixes.
featureFallbacks.002: After the standard separation, drums, vocals and the other instruments are split further into detail stems in the background: kick, snare, toms, hi-hat and cymbals; lead and backing vocals; instrument families.

gallery.title: Mixer with detail groups
gallery.caption: Every stem gets a fader, pan, mute, solo and a peak meter. Expanded stems open a group with their detail stems.

gallery.title: Import
gallery.caption: Paste a YouTube or Spotify link, or drop an MP3, WAV or FLAC file. The personal-practice notice is part of the screen.

gallery.title: Tracks
gallery.caption: Your imported songs with artist, status and length.

gallery.title: Track with cover and band info
gallery.caption: Cover art and band facts from open data, with attribution, next to the processing state and the stems.

gallery.title: Library
gallery.caption: Exported stems and mixes, ready to download, rename or delete.

gallery.title: Expert mixer
gallery.caption: The expert level adds presets, keyboard shortcuts and numeric entry for gain and pan.
